subject.size_in_frame: whole figure, small — about one fifth of frame height, exactly as in sh001

headroom: about 0.13 of frame height of empty shaft above her crown — reproduced from sh001 without adjustment.
horizon_eyeline: No horizon; the bookshelf edges and map-peg rails are the travelling horizontals. Her eyeline sits at 0.30 of frame height, level with the lens, as before.

layers.fg: the nearest bookshelf edge rising through the lower right corner, where the cupboard door was in sh001
layers.mg: Alice at the same place in frame, now settling back into the fall as if into an armchair, ankles crossing, hands coming to her lap
layers.bg: the second pass — bookshelves and schoolroom maps on pegs, each level cooler than the one above — and below her the open drop going black

gaze.note: the one deliberate difference from sh001: there she looked frame left at the glazed cupboards; here she looks frame right at the bookshelves, which is the wall this pass belongs to. Same body, same place in frame, turned the other way — a later moment of the same descent, not a new shot.

balance: Identical to sh001: top-heavy, the lower two thirds given to dressing and dark. The recognition depends on nothing being adjusted.
leading_lines: The same funnel of converging shaft walls and the same ladder of travelling horizontals; only the furniture on the rungs has changed.
eye_first: Her face and floating hair, as before — and the audience should recognise the frame before they read the new dressing. That order is the point.
constraint_binding: Pass 2 only: bookshelves and schoolroom maps on pegs, no cupboard or jar in frame, each level cooler than the one above. Must read as a later moment of the same descent — so anchor_xy, subject scale, headroom and lens axis are reproduced from sh001 exactly.
pairs_with: sh001 — the same locked set-up. Composition reproduced element for element; the only licensed differences are the dressing and her gaze direction.
